message: Day 1 - hiked from camp to lake morena! Mile 0 to 20 hope yall are doing well
Day 2 - made it to mile 37.6, really beautiful and an amazing day!
Day 3 - made it to mile 52.5
Day 4 - made it to mile 73.1 going to be in town tomorrow so will call! Night yall
Day 6 - made it to mile 94. New lighter gear is great. Got a blister with my new shoes but the foot pain is gone!
Day 7 - made it to mile 112.5!
Day 8 - made it to mile 131. It was a tough day for cold. Really happy with my setup! Blister still forming sadly
Day 9 - made it to mile 142.5
Day 10 - made it to mile 151.8 paradise valley cafe, then hitched to idyllwild where i am spending the night. Back to trail tomorrow
Day 11 - made it to 162.6! Beautiful ridge walk today and got to camp by a spring. Feel are appreciating the two lighter days.
Day 11 - made it to 162.6! Beautiful ridge walk today and got to camp by a spring. Feel are appreciating the two lighter days.
Day 12 - made it to mile 177.3! We are camping at 8000 feet. Turns out there is quite a bit of elevation in southern california
Day 13 - made it to mile 190.4 took a detour to summit san jacinto mountain. Pretty wild there is a mountain at 10k in so cal
Day 14 - made it to mile 211.6! Started with a 15 mile hike down where we lost 8k of feet. Got an uber into town and then went back to the trail!
Day 15 - made it to mile 228.1. Really hot desert heat but hiked early and late, and hung out by water in the heart of the day.
Day 16 - made it to mile 241. Slightly shorter day because the trail was destroyed by rain, also did 5000 feet of vertical
Day 17 - made it to mile 266. About to head into big bear for two days! Look out for a call
Day 18 - first zero day!!!
Day 19 - another zero day! Mile 266
Day 20 - made it to mile 288.4. Ended up being a big day but feels good to get some miles in after the break. Next town days i will do less walking.
Day 21 - made it to mile 307.9 got to camp next to a natural hot springs! Was very cool
Day 22 - made it to mile 328.8, staying at a campground!
Day 23 - made it to mile 347. Will be going in town tomorrow and trying to figure out my shoe situation. Look for a call tomorrow!
Day 24 stayed in wrightwood and got new shoes! Off to the trail tomorrow
Day 25 - made it to mile 383.9 past the closure. Did 11 in the new shoes and they are working well.
Day 26 - made it to 406.7. There was a closure for an endangered frog so it meant we had some road walking. Feet feel great, thanks for the luko tape rec sky!
Day 27 - made it to 430.4! Will be in town tomorrow night
Day 28 - made it to 454.7! Third consecutive day doing 24, taking it easy tomorrow, in aqua dulce! Hope yall are doing well
Day 29 - made it to mile 468.2 was an easier day (13 miles) but very needed!
Day 30 - made it to mile 489.9! Beautiful day, really surprised how the desert is different each day
Day 31 - made it to mile 510.9! Weird to think it has been 500 miles and over a month. Really beautiful day, headed to hike in the flat desert tomorrow
Day 32 - made it to mile 535! Did seven early miles then did 17 at night starting at 8pm to avoid the heat.
Day 33 - made it to mile 558.0! Will be in tehachapi tomorrow! Also schuyler there have been so many windmills you were right. Sounds like im sleeping at the airport
Day 34 - went into tehachapi, mile 566
Day 35 - made it to mile 570. Just took it really easy today! Longer days start back up tomorrow
Day 36 - made it to mile 594.1 day was overall good but the long water and food carry are starting to get me. Pack is getting lighter each day!
Day 37 - made it to mile 613.2. It was a pretty good day, starting to get out of the desert.
Day 38 - made it to mile 639.6 the day was long but rewarding. Did my first marathon day! Getting soo close to sierras
Day 39 - made it to mile 658.1. Getting closer to Kennedy meadows!!
Day 40 - made it to mile 682! Will be in Kennedy meadows south tomorrow night!
Day 41 - made it to mile 703! Staying at this place called grumpies! Very interesting place. Zeroing tomorrow. Will try to call, service is not good
Day 42 zeroed in Kennedy meadows
Day 43 - made it to mile 705.8. Very short day just to get on the trail. Back at it tomorrow!
Day 44 - made it to mile 723. Can really feel the diff being in the Sierras. Mosquitos though are not fun
Day 45 - made it to mile 744.1. First full day around 10000 feet. Makes the 2000 ft climb much more interesting
Day 46 - made it to mile 761.6. Most beautiful day yet!
D49 M775.9 today was a very relaxed day, there is a mountain pass we want to do but want to do it in the morning. Will be doing it very early tomorrow morning.
D50 m790 made it to bishop! Big day and really fun day! Will share pictures in family chat
D51 was in bishop
D52 hiked up keysharge pass,
D53 m801 long day mentally for me. I did another pass today and got back on trail, set up tomorrow for one more! Making progress
D55 m835 the sierras are so beautiful! Spirits yesterday were low because i lost my spoon. Resorting to using a tent stake and burritos… not ideal.
D56 m853.6 spirits are higher. I ate my food via the bakers piping method. Ty lynn for rec! 4th pass in 4 days done. 1 more tomorrow then break in vvr
D57 m874.6 Big day prepping to go resupply and hangout at vvr! This area is so wild. Did 5th pass and should be mostly done over 11,000 feet now.
D58 made it to vvr and then went to a friends cabin by hunnington lake
D59 had a bday party for a friend, and zeroed at vvr
D60 m892 back on trail! Hiked up another mountain pass. Tomorrow to mammoth.
D61 went into mammoth
D62 m917.1 back on trail! Going to yosemite in the next two days!
D63 m932.9 made it to yosemite!
D64 m949.6 went through tuolumne meadows! Unbelievably beautiful! I have 70 miles till kmn, so i am thinking we can talk then? Should be in 4 days
D65 m969.7 Continued in ynp and it was beautiful! Weird that it was the day i saw the fewest people. Funny how 20s in the sierras is way harder than the desert.
D66 m988 yosemite is really amazing. The only problem is the mosquitos. I am so surprised how empty the trails feel. Makes me want to come back.
D67 m1005 Hit mile 1000 today! Was hoping to go further but hit my first weather since week one. Thunderstorm! Left yosemite and found very different atmosphere
D68 m1018 made it to kmn
D69 m1037.4 back on trail! Great day. Did not realize how much i needed a shower! Will be in south lake tahoe in 2 daysish!
D70 m1064.2 Another great day! Saw a bunch of day hikers and the scenery was amazing. 2nd marathon day of the trail! 27 miles to south lake!
D71 m1091.9 made it to highway fifty and will be heading to south lake tahoe for the day tomorrow. Makes it feel very surreal to be here.
D72 0 day in south lake tahoe
D73 m1104.5 hiked in desolation wilderness. Very beautiful but always hard to leave town
D74 m1125.9 hiked along tahoe rim trail! Great and beautiful day
D75 m1147.7 last day on the tahoe rim trail, amazing views, best camp site on trail
D76 m1154 made it to donner pass! Time for a trail vacation
D77 zero!
D78 m1161 trail magic a success. All pork eaten. Short day to get back on trail
D79 m1191.9 big day today! Really pretty, first 30 mile day. In to sierra city tomorrow for breakfast
D80 m1213.5 hiked to sierra city. Two milkshakes in one day is not a good idea. But then saw a great sunset! Great day
D81 m1238.6 another beautiful day!
D82 m1261.6 cruising in northern california!
D83 m1288.1 went to bucks lake and did a resupply! One of the best days on trail so beautiful and bucks lake was so friendly
D84 m1312.2 really tough day of climbing. Did a 4k climb out of beldon. Into chester tomorrow!
D85 m1332.8 made it to the half way point!
D86 m1351.7 back on trail after spending the night in chester. Went into lassan national park. Tomorrow hiking through!
D87 m1378.8 finshed going through lassan and went into old station. Now heading toward shasta!
D88 m1408.4 hiked along the hat creek rim. Was awesome to see Shasta and lassen in the same landscape.
D90 got distracted dealing with a thunder storm will complete check in tonight everything is ok
D89 m1411.3 stayed at the burney mountain guest ranch! Very nice and pleasant
D90 m1434.8 went to burney falls and had a good day of hiking until a thunder storm rolled in. Not used to this rain thing :)
D91 m1465.4 got insanely wet today from the brush after the rain storm. Making progress
D92 m1497.9 great day just outside of mount shasta! In town tomorrow
D93 m1512.9 great day in shasta! Setting ourselves up for an epic climb to start the morning. 208 miles to go to get to ashland!
D94 m1541.2 amazing views today and big climbs
D95 m1566.4 another day another rain storm, very beautiful section
D96 m1601/1581 fire caused us to get off trail and skip that section, my friend saw the fire start and called it in. Edna was amazing
D97 m1615.3 another set of thunder storms made the day short, will make up for it tomorrow!
D98 m1643.1 went through the trinity alps! So beautiful. Off to sied valley
D99 m1672.3 last night in california!
D100 m1700 made if out of california! 21 miles to ashland
D101 m1721 made it to ashland!
D102 m1733.6 had a shorter day to get my legs back under me! Also did forget my sunglasses at the hotel. Did get them back though!
D103 m1764.8 long day but overall very good
D104 m1791.0 feeling better, surprisingly hard to jump back into it. Hope tomorrow will be even better!
D105 m1823.3 made it to crater lake! Time to enjoy a good meal and a shower
D106 m1842.6 explored crater lake. Really beautiful and very amazing.
D107 m1873.6 hiked out of clnp, had most epic trail magic. Kodiak blueberry pancakes! Then continued on. We will see if i will make it to shelter cove tomorrow
D107 m1908.2 dont let the number deceive you i did an alternate to shelter cove. 27 miles. Trail was rough to start but got way better.
D108 m1931.9 left shelter cove and ran into some nice lakes! Working my way to bend!
D109 m1960.3 hiked by mt bachelor. Confirmed it is the place for us to do a family ski trip next winter
D110 m1985.3 hiked to mckenzie pass to get into bend
D111 m1985.3 stayed in bend for the day
D112 m2003.6 made it to mile 2000! Happy to be back on trail
D113 m2034.3 another day, lots of smoke but very beautiful!
D114 m2067 amazing view of mt jefferson! Great day of hiking.
D115 m2089.7 made it to frog lake and my friend shane came to pick me up with his dad. Great night with him and drove me back to trail
D116 m2109.9 back on trail! Hiked around mt hood with some epic views! Lots of fun. Nice to have a short restbit and still get 20 miles in.
D117 m2137.7 hiked through tunnel falls!
D118 m2150.3 hiked to cascade locks and spent the night there!
D119 m2170.5 shorter day but had some elevation to gain. Washington is beautiful!!!! Soo green but also humid
D120 m2196.2 big elevation day. Washington is very humid and very green
D121 m2227.0 long day of hiking but cruisy like oregon. Into trout lake tomorrow!
D122 m2245 went to trout lake! Had views of adams and tahoma! Really amazing
D123 m2267.8 shorter hiking day but really nice! Walking in goat rock wilderness park
D124 m2289.9 amazing views! Finally above tree line
D125.5 m2298.1 made it to cracker barrel where i met up with uncle chris and got a new shoes!
D125 m2337.4 after skipping up  to avoid the fire closure, hiked 10 miles in! Very beautiful
D126 m2362.6 chugged along in washington! Really beautiful
D127 m2387.5 made it to mirror lake. Off to snoqualmie tomorrow. 8.9 out so will get an early start tomorrow
D128 m2403.5 had a great day in snoqualmie and saw uncle chris. Another great day. Went back to trail, rested up for some bigger days ahead
D129 m2431 amazing day! Washington is my favorite state so far. Got some different weather, cool to see some views with clouds
D130 m2453.3 tougher day. Lots of elevation. Very clear this is all mental at this point. Seeing uc at stevens pass tomorrow
D131 m2484.4 great day! Saw uncle chris had to take an alternate for a fire. Feeling way more refueled after seeing him.
D132 m2505.1 amazing views! Washington is continuing to be amazing
D132 m2424.6 decided to do less big days before end of trail and enjoying the longer breaks to soak in the views! Great day for views
D133 m2547.6 great day with great views. Washington is amazing!
D134 m2575.1 made it to stehekin. Last resupply of trail
D135 m2586.3 left stehekin and back on trail. Got a new foam pad so now i can finally sleep!
D136 m2612.6 another beautiful day!!! Walked along a really beautiful ridge for half the day
D137 m2636.2 made it to hearts pass! Then hiked another 10 or so. < 20 miles to the border!
D137.5 m2655.8 made it to the border!
D138 m2655.8+8.4 got back to my tent after slack packing. 22 miles left to get back to harts pass! Weird to think tomorrow is the last day
